children: Iridium entered into a Fourth Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement to secure lender consent for its pending merger with Rocket Lab. The amendment provides that the deal will not trigger a change-of-control under the facility and requires a downstream guarantee from Rocket Lab USA at closing. Post-closing, interest margins on term loans will increase, with a 1% prepayment premium for repricing transactions and a 1% exit fee on term loan prepayments after the first anniversary. The term loans are permitted to remain outstanding following the transaction.
